newsitem.title: USA: Alcoa Q3 oper shr $0.77 before charge.
newsitem.headline: Alcoa Q3 oper shr $0.77 before charge.

text.p: Note: 1996 Q3 oper share before special aftertax charge of $65.5 million, ($115 million pretax). or $0.38 a share, for layoff provision and equipment write-down.
After the charge, net income was $68.4 million, or $0.39 a share in the 1996 qtr.

Third quarter 1996 earnings were hurt by the strike at the Cleveland forging plant by $6.5 million, or $0.04 per share, and also included after-tax losses of $16 million, or $0.09 per share, resulting from marking to market certain aluminum commodity contracts.

The company said it enters into these commodity contracts to lock in conversion margins for fabricated product businesses, and to have its primary metal units at market prices at all times. Of these losses, $3.4 million, or $0.02 per share, is attributable to fabricated product sales contracts that were delivered during the third quarter and $12.6 million, or $0.07 per share, is related to fabricated product sales contracts that will be shipped in future quarters.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1996 9 mths excludes after tax charges of $105.5 million, or $0.61 a share
After the charge, 1996 9-mth net was $378.8 million, or $2.16 a share.
The year-to-date charges include the layoff provision and a second quarter charge of $40.0 million for closing ceramic packaging operations in California.

Revenue amounts for sales and operating revenues. They do not include other income of $18 million vs $61.3 million in qtr, $36.6 vs $118.9 million in 9 mths. Total revenues including other income are $3,258.6 million vs $3,326.1 million in qtr, $9,839.9 million vs $9,510.8 million in 9 mths.
